fields.description: Issue features strong editorial attacks on Florida Gov. Fuller Warren and the Miami Herald, arguing the press and special interests pushed an inequitable state sales tax. Reports include a deep test oil well spudded by Coastal Petroleum Company on Crossman Hammock southwest of Coral Gables, discussion of Miami Beach controversies including a death following detention at the Miami Retreat, commentary on gambling/lottery activity on Lincoln Road, and local court digests on petty larceny and vagrancy. Additional pieces address civic politics (including Junior Chamber of Commerce activity), annexation of Biscayne Key, and national/international commentary on U.S. war preparations and West Germany as an ally.
